instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand resting against the front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
2. Brace your core and keep a slight bend in the elbows.
3. Raise the right dumbbell straight in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
4. Lower it back down with control.
5. Repeat with the left arm, then continue alternating.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and do not swing the weights or use momentum.
2. Keep your torso still and avoid leaning back.
3. Stop the raise at shoulder height.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Vertical Front Raises

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand behind your neck, palms facing forward, elbows bent and flared out.
2. Brace your core and keep your chest up.
3. Press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
4. Lower the dumbbells back to behind-neck height with control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press only within a comfortable shoulder range to protect the joint.
2. Keep your core tight to stop your lower back from arching.
3. Move under control and do not bounce at the bottom.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Standing Behind Back Shoulders Press

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, knees slightly bent.
2. Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is almost parallel to the floor, keeping your back flat.
3. Tuck your upper arms against your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
4. Extend both elbows to drive the dumbbells straight back until your arms are straight.
5. Bend your elbows to return to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms still and pinned to your sides.
2. Keep your back flat and do not round the shoulders.
3. Squeeze the triceps hard at full extension.
4. Exhale as you extend, inhale as you return.
name: Dumbbell Standing Both Arms Kickback

instructions:
1. Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Keep your posture straight and core engaged.
3. Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
4. Hold the top briefly and squeeze your calves.
5. Lower your heels back down with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and avoid bouncing at the top or bottom.
2. Rise as high as you can onto your toes for a full contraction.
3. Keep your knees straight to bias the gastrocnemius.
4. Keep your torso upright throughout.
name: Dumbbell standing calf raise

instructions:
1. Stand on a step with the balls of your feet on the edge and heels hanging off, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Keep your posture straight and core engaged.
3. Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
4. Hold the top briefly and squeeze your calves.
5. Lower your heels below the step edge to feel a full stretch.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Make sure the step is stable before you start.
2. Let the heels drop fully for a complete stretch each rep.
3. Move slowly and avoid bouncing.
4. Keep your knees straight to bias the gastrocnemius.
name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise on Step
